name: Olean's Cafe
ownershipEvidence: Visit Tallahassee states that Olean McCaskill owns and operates the café; Black Restaurant Week identifies Olean McCaskill and her husband Johnny as founders and describes the business among Black-owned Tallahassee culinary businesses.
notes: Visit Tallahassee gives the numbered address and states the café is directly across from FAMU's campus. Research only; proximity described by source, not independently measured.

name: SneauxBall Catering Co.
ownershipEvidence: The official SneauxBall bio says Jarrett Maloy is the founder and owner; Black Restaurant Week explicitly labels its Tallahassee culinary-business feature as Black-owned and identifies Jarrett Maloy as owner.
notes: Official location page lists Store Front | 2033 S. Adams St.; official bio repeats the address and owner. Address is also independently listed by Black Restaurant Week.

name: Pineappetit
ownershipEvidence: Pineappetit's official press kit states it is a Florida-based, Black-owned culinary brand founded by Chef Samuel Burgess and identifies him as Founder & Owner.
notes: Official website lists Restaurant: 626-2A Railroad Square, Tallahassee, FL 32310. The same site says the founder began the business while studying at FAMU; Black Restaurant Week independently lists a Tallahassee address and website.
